name: zzsearch
title: Zzsearch
description: Throwaway standalone acceptance connector, read-only-kit style with search tools. Covers both search schema shapes in one package: a no-args tool that calls the shared searchToolInputSchema and plucks a `rows` envelope, and an args-carrying tool that inlines its own zod object and passes the response straight through.

tools.name: zzsearch_item_search
tools.description: Substring search across items. Matches id, name, status and any tag names.

tools.name: zzsearch_build_search
tools.description: Substring search across one project's builds. Matches branch and status.
